contest.title: Competition rules | AJSEE × Colosseum Ticket
contest.description: Official rules for the competition to win two pairs of tickets to Filmový orchestr Praha at Nová Spirála. Follow AJSEE and enter on Instagram.

contestRules.title: AJSEE and Colosseum Ticket Instagram competition rules
contestRules.subtitle: Win 2 pairs of tickets to Filmový orchestr Praha at Nová Spirála
contestRules.intro: We are holding this competition to celebrate the launch of the partnership between AJSEE and Colosseum Ticket. Two winners will each receive two tickets to the Filmový orchestr Praha concert on 30 May 2027 at 19:00 at Nová Spirála in Prague.
contestRules.label: Official competition rules
contestRules.section1Body:
The competition organiser is AJSEE LTD, registered in England and Wales under company number 17105762, with its registered office at 71–75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom (the “organiser”).

Competition contact email: adam@ajsee.cz. The organiser’s Instagram profile: @ajseeofficial.

The competition partner and ticket provider is Perfect System, s.r.o., company identification number 26480981, with its registered office at Radlická 3301/68, 150 00 Praha 5, operating the Colosseum Ticket brand (the “partner”). The partner will arrange the reservation and issue the prize tickets; AJSEE will organise the competition and communicate with entrants.
contestRules.section2Body:
The competition takes place on Instagram under the main competition post on @ajseeofficial, expressly announcing the competition for 2 pairs of tickets to Filmový orchestr Praha at Nová Spirála.

  • Opening: Tuesday 20 October 2026 at 19:00.
  • Closing: Sunday 1 November 2026 at 23:59 inclusive.
  • Draw and announcement: Monday 2 November 2026; the selected winners will be announced at 19:00.

All times are local times applicable in the Czech Republic, in the Europe/Prague time zone.

Only comments submitted under this main post during the competition period count as entries. Comments under other posts, private messages and reactions to Stories will not be included in the draw.
contestRules.section3Body:
The competition is open to individuals who are 18 or over when entering, use their own personal Instagram account and meet these rules. They must be able to provide a valid email address to receive electronic tickets.

People directly involved in preparing or evaluating the competition, and members of their household, may not enter.

Entry is free and does not require a purchase of tickets or any other service. A public Instagram profile is not required.
contestRules.section4Body:
Entrants must meet all the following requirements:

  1. Follow the Instagram profile @ajseeofficial.
  2. Comment under the main competition post and use @ to tag the personal profile of someone they would like to attend the concert with.
  3. In the same comment, say which film soundtrack or film melody they would like to hear live.

The tag and answer must be in the same comment. Entrants cannot tag themselves as their guest. Being tagged does not make the tagged person an entrant, and that person does not have to follow AJSEE. The winner may choose a different guest by agreement.

Following AJSEE is mandatory at entry, at the competition closing time and when the selected winner’s eligibility is checked before the prize is confirmed.

The competition comment must remain accessible to the organiser until the competition is evaluated. If a comment is incomplete, the entrant may submit a new, complete comment before the closing time. Missing entry requirements cannot be met after the closing time.

The answer expresses a personal preference. Its originality and whether it matches the actual concert programme will not be assessed. Naming a piece in a competition comment does not mean it will be performed at the concert.

Liking or sharing the post, or following other profiles, is not required.
contestRules.section5Title: 5. Number of entries and chances of winning
contestRules.section5Toc: Number of entries and chances of winning
contestRules.section5Body:
Each person will be entered into the draw only once, regardless of how many comments they submit. Their first comment meeting all requirements will be used for the entry record.

Additional comments or tags do not increase the chance of winning. One person must not enter using multiple Instagram accounts.

Every valid entrant has an equal chance in the draw. One person may win no more than one prize.
contestRules.section6Body:
A total of two prizes will be awarded. Each consists of two tickets to the following concert:

  • Concert: Filmový orchestr Praha at Nová Spirála.
  • Date and time: 30 May 2027 at 19:00.
  • Venue: Nová Spirála, Prague.

There are four tickets in total, divided between two winners. The partner will determine the specific seats and ticket category and inform the winner when confirming the reservation.

The prize includes tickets only. The winner and their guest pay for transport, accommodation and any other personal expenses. The prize cannot be paid in cash or exchanged for tickets to another event at the winner’s request. The concert’s admission and ticket terms also apply when using the tickets.
contestRules.section7Body:
On 2 November 2026, the organiser will randomly select two different winners from a list of unique entrants whose comments meet the requirements. The organiser may also draw reserve winners and record their order.

The organiser will check that each selected entrant meets the rules, particularly following @ajseeofficial, meeting the age requirement and submitting a qualifying comment. Where there is a reasonable doubt, proportionate evidence of eligibility may be requested.

If a selected entrant is ineligible, declines the prize or fails to claim it under section 8, the organiser will contact the next reserve winner. If the reserve list is insufficient, another random draw will be held among the remaining valid entrants.

The organiser will retain a record of the draw to demonstrate that the competition was conducted properly. Neither the soundtrack answer nor the number of likes on a comment affects the outcome.

If there are fewer than two valid entrants, only the corresponding number of prizes may be awarded. If there are no valid entrants, no draw will take place. The organiser will announce this in the same way as the competition results.
contestRules.section8Body:
The selected winners’ Instagram usernames will be announced on 2 November 2026 at 19:00 on @ajseeofficial, in Stories and in a comment under the main competition post. The prize will be finally confirmed once eligibility has been verified.

The organiser will contact winners by private message from @ajseeofficial. Winners must respond within five calendar days of that message being sent, confirm acceptance and provide their first name, surname and email address for the reservation and delivery of tickets.

If a winner does not respond within this period or does not provide the details needed to deliver the prize, a reserve winner will be contacted. The same response period applies to every reserve winner contacted.

After confirming the prize, the organiser will pass the necessary details to the partner’s reservations department. The winner will receive an email confirming the reservation and delivery arrangements. Tickets will be delivered electronically no later than seven calendar days before the concert, unless the winner and organiser expressly agree otherwise.

No fee is payable to claim the prize. Winners are responsible for providing the correct email address and cooperating as necessary for ticket delivery.
contestRules.section9Body:
Comments that do not meet the rules, are submitted outside the competition period or are removed before evaluation will not enter the draw.

The organiser may disqualify entries obtained through fraud, one person’s use of multiple accounts, impersonation or automated accounts. Comments containing unlawful content, threats or gross personal abuse may also be removed.

Disqualification must be based on a specific breach of these rules. The organiser will explain the reason at the entrant’s request. The right to request an explanation or exercise statutory rights is unaffected.
contestRules.section10Body:
Any changes to the concert programme, time or venue, or cancellation of the concert, will be handled under the terms of the concert organiser and ticket provider. In cooperation with the partner, AJSEE will inform winners of changes it becomes aware of and the next steps. This does not limit any rights granted to winners under applicable law.

Questions and concerns about the competition may be sent to adam@ajsee.cz. The organiser will assess them and respond without undue delay.
contestRules.section11Body:
The controller of personal data processed to organise this competition is AJSEE LTD, identified in section 1. Contact for personal data requests: adam@ajsee.cz.

The organiser processes Instagram usernames, competition comments, information about fulfilment of the requirements and the draw record. For winners, it also processes first name, surname, email address and the communication needed to deliver the prize.

Data needed for entry and prize delivery is processed to perform the competition terms under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Checking fair conduct, documenting the draw and protecting legal claims rely on legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. On the same basis, the organiser will publish only winners’ Instagram usernames to announce the results transparently, not their email addresses or other private contact details.

Information about the tagged guest is used only as part of the comment to verify entry requirements, based on the legitimate interest in properly administering the competition. Being tagged does not enter that person into the draw or subscribe them to marketing communications.

The organiser will provide winners’ first name, surname and email address to Perfect System, s.r.o., solely for reserving, issuing and delivering tickets and related communication. The partner’s subsequent processing is governed by its privacy policy: https://colosseum.eu/gdpr. Contracted service providers needed for communication and secure storage may also access data to the appropriate extent and subject to the relevant data protection conditions.

AJSEE LTD is based in the United Kingdom. Transfers of personal data from the European Economic Area to the United Kingdom rely on the European Commission’s applicable adequacy decision. Instagram also processes data independently under Meta’s policies, including its international transfer rules.

The organiser will delete or anonymise its internal records of non-winning entrants no later than three months after the winners are announced. Winners’ data needed to deliver and administer the prize will be kept for no longer than six months after the concert. Longer retention is permitted only to the extent necessary for a specific legal dispute or statutory obligation. Published announcements containing winners’ usernames will be removed or amended no later than six months after the announcement. Entrants may manage their comments through Instagram; deleting a comment before evaluation affects eligibility under these rules.

Subject to the legal conditions, entrants have the right to access, rectify and erase data, restrict processing and receive data portability. They may object to processing based on legitimate interests. They may also complain to the competent supervisory authority, such as the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection or the UK Information Commissioner’s Office.

Providing the data necessary for entry and prize delivery is a condition for administering the entry or prize; the relevant step cannot take place without it. Entrants may withdraw from the competition by messaging the organiser. Software may be used for random selection; the organiser verifies eligibility and confirms prizes. Personal data is not used for profiling in this competition.

Entering the competition or following the Instagram profile does not constitute consent to receiving marketing emails. Further information about AJSEE’s data processing is available at https://ajsee.cz/privacy-policy.
contestRules.section12Body:
The competition is not sponsored, endorsed or administered by, or associated with, Instagram. Instagram is neither the organiser nor the prize provider.

By entering, each entrant releases Instagram from liability for the organisation and conduct of this competition and delivery of prizes to the extent permitted by applicable law. This provision does not limit rights that cannot legally be waived.
contestRules.section13Body:
By entering, entrants confirm that they have read these rules and meet the eligibility requirements. During the competition, the rules are available through the link in the BIO of @ajseeofficial.

The organiser may amend the rules or suspend the competition only for serious and objective reasons, such as a major technical problem, force majeure or the need to ensure fair conduct. Changes, their reasons and their impact will be announced on AJSEE’s profile and in the rules. Changes must not retrospectively disadvantage valid entries or be used to arbitrarily refuse promised prizes.

The competition is governed by these rules and applicable law. No provision limits entrants’ statutory rights or their ability to contact a competent authority or court.

This is a separate competition. Entering another AJSEE competition, including the London musicals competition, does not constitute entry into this one. Each competition has its own post, prizes and terms.
